// Appendix listing every normative rule and linking back to the specification
// text that defines it.
//
// The table rows are generated by scripts/create_norm_rule_tables.py from the
// normative tag JSON and the normative rule definition files, so this appendix
// is only included when those fragments have been generated. Build it with:
//
//   make build-norm-rules-appendix-pdf
//
// See tagging_normative_rules.adoc for how normative text is tagged.
ifdef::norm-rules-appendix-dir[]
[appendix]
[[app:norm-rules]]
== Normative Rules

This appendix indexes the normative rules defined by this specification.
Each row names a rule, summarizes it, and links to the tagged text that
states it along with the section that text appears in.

The rule names and the mapping from rules to tagged text are maintained in
the normative rule definition files; the tags themselves are anchors in the
specification source. Both are described in the
link:https://github.com/riscv/riscv-isa-manual/blob/main/tagging_normative_rules.adoc[normative rule tagging guide].

include::{norm-rules-appendix-dir}/all_norm_rules_by_chapter.adoc[]
endif::[]
